description: I'm an Engineering student passionate about Aerospace Engineering, space exploration, and innovation. I have experience in SolidWorks, ANSYS, MATLAB, Arduino, and mechanical design. I'm working on LUNA-OPS, an intelligent lunar landing site and mission planning platform for NASA Space Apps 2026. I'm looking for motivated teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, data science, GIS, web development, 3D visualization, or space science. Teamwork, creativity, and passion are what matter most!
